title: A study of degenerate Bernoulli and Euler numbers via operators
summary: The paper introduces novel classes of operators and investigates their applications to the study of special numbers. We utilize these operators to derive explicit expressions for degenerate Euler numbers and type 2 degenerate Euler numbers. Furthermore, we establish a relationship between degenerate Bernoulli numbers and degenerate Euler numbers. We note here that these operators emerge naturally when we study such explicit expressions and such a relationship
